items.title: Jason Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2025
items.q: Mark Turner is on that record and Marcus Gilmore and Larry Grenadier.

ctx.x: Yeah. The current scene that — you’re saying after all these years you finally led a band. Do you have to get an agent to really make that happen for you?

Yeah well you know the — I have a local band, you know a band of cats in Boston that I play with regularly. You know we did a concert last week for International Jazz Day. And so that band, you know we’ve done things, you know, regionally. We played the Chicago Jazz Festival and stuff. But for my latest, my last two or three records I’ve used people in New York and so there are slightly different projects with different kinds of compositions and everything. And so I recently got an agent, a booking agent, that’s…
You brought up “The Crossover,” and I had a question about — I think that’s the name of the tune as well, correct?
